visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and glasses wearing a light blue shirt stands in a bright kitchen holding a gold box of LeTAO cookies. She gestures with her hands while speaking to the camera. (2) Close-up shots of the gold and white 'THENOIR' box being opened, revealing many individually wrapped white packages inside. A hand picks up one package and takes out a thin, square brown cookie with a dark chocolate filling visible. (3) In the kitchen, a glass bowl contains softened pale yellow butter. A hand uses a black whisk to mix the butter with white powdered sugar until a smooth, creamy paste forms. (4) The woman holds a red bag of 'Tea Powder' and smells it. The background suddenly shifts to a lush green tea plantation under a clear sky. She smiles and nods. (5) Back in the kitchen, brown tea powder is added to the butter mixture and whisked in. A hand then sifts white flour into the bowl and folds it with a pink spatula to create a thick brown batter. (6) The batter is piped from a pastry bag into a square-celled silicone mold on a white tray. A metal spatula levels the batter. A tiny, digitally inserted version of the woman walks across the squares. (7) The tray is placed in a black oven with a digital display showing '160°C' and '12'. The cookies bake until they are firm. (8) On a wooden board, dark chocolate bars are chopped into small pieces. The chocolate is melted in a glass bowl, and more tea powder is mixed in to create a dark, glossy filling which is then piped into a mold and chilled in a white refrigerator. (9) The woman sandwiches a square of chilled tea chocolate between two baked cookies. She stacks them on a white plate and places them into a green and white decorative tin box next to a cup of tea.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天來復刻. (2) [Subtitle]: LeTAO的紅茶巧克力餅乾. [Logo]: @ciao_kitchen. (3) [Subtitle]: 準備餅乾材料. (4) [Subtitle]: 先來做餅乾麵糊. (5) [Subtitle]: 把室溫奶油跟糖粉. (6) [Subtitle]: 攪拌均勻就好 不用打發. (7) [Subtitle]: 蛋白也是要常溫的喔. (8) [Subtitle]: 分三次加入 慢慢拌進去. (9) [Subtitle]: 避免油水分離. (10) [Subtitle]: 接著是今天的主角. (11) [Subtitle]: 紅玉紅茶粉. (12) [Subtitle]: 香氣超清爽. (13) [Subtitle]: 誒? 怎麼到茶園了. (14) [Subtitle]: 來都來了～. (15) [Subtitle]: 我用的是舞間茶心的茶粉. (16) [Subtitle]: 細到不用過篩. (17) [Subtitle]: 不會結塊. (18) [Subtitle]: 加一點點就很香. (19) [Subtitle]: 篩入低筋麵粉拌一拌. (20) [Subtitle]: 麵糊就完成啦. (21) [Subtitle]: 擠進模具內. (22) [Subtitle]: 這款餅乾不太會膨脹或變形. (23) [Subtitle]: 可以排緊一點. (24) [Subtitle]: 用刮板把表面刮平. (25) [Variety]: 完蛋惹. [Slogan]: 老闆對不齊~. (26) [Subtitle]: 再小心地把模具拿起來. (27) [Subtitle]: 看到整齊的麵糊. (28) [Subtitle]: 真的有夠療癒. (29) [Subtitle]: 送進烤箱 160度烤12分鐘. (30) [Subtitle]: 來做紅茶巧克力夾心. (31) [Subtitle]: 牛奶巧克力融化後. (32) [Subtitle]: 加入紅茶粉拌一拌. (33) [Subtitle]: 茶香跟奶味融合地剛剛好. (34) [Subtitle]: 倒入模具內抹平. (35) [Variety]: 你不可以過. [Logo]: (Footprint icon). (36) [Subtitle]: 冷藏15分鐘讓它定型. (37) [Subtitle]: 夾心定型後 小心取出. (38) [Subtitle]: 夾入餅乾中間. (39) [Subtitle]: 復刻版 LeTAO 完成!

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with short black hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses, a light blue short-sleeved blouse, and occasionally a brown apron.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, bright residential kitchen with white cabinets, a white marble countertop, and various kitchen utensils including whisks, bowls, and ingredients. Later, a digitally inserted background of a terraced green tea plantation under a clear blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Friendly female narration begins over an upbeat, major-key acoustic guitar BGM. (2) A subtle 'thud' sound effect accompanies a close-up of a box. (3) Continuous whisking sounds against glass are heard as the narrator explains the butter mixture. (4) A sniffing sound occurs, followed immediately by a magical 'chime' transition effect. (5) Outdoor bird chirping ambiance fades in briefly, then out as the scene returns to the kitchen. (6) A sharp 'ping' sound effect marks the completion of the sifting step. (7) Playful, percussive cartoon walking sound effects ('tu-tu-tu') play as a tiny character moves on screen. (8) Rhythmic 'thud' sounds of a knife chopping chocolate on a wooden board. (9) A metallic 'clink' and 'scraping' sound as chocolate is mixed. (10) More comedic 'spring' and 'slide' sound effects accompany animated footstep graphics. (11) A crisp 'click' or 'snap' sound signifies the final sandwiching of the cookie pieces. (12) The BGM swells slightly as the final product is presented with a triumphant vocal tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredients -> Step-by-Step Process -> Final Result.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a detailed, engaging tutorial for recreating the famous LeTAO tea chocolate cookies at home, emphasizing the use of high-quality tea powder from the brand 舞間茶心.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically mentions the brand '舞間茶心' (Wujian Chaxin), praises its fine texture and aroma, and features a background transition to a tea garden to emphasize its origin.
